metadata.question: Is the chlorophyll-a concentration higher in the southern coastal waters of Java (-8.879787, 110.2273416) compared to the northern Java Sea waters (-5.741852, 109.953683) on August 4, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use ocean color data for chlorophyll-a concentration - Best options: MODIS Aqua (MODIS/006/MCD43A4 is land), or Sentinel-3 OLCI, or MODIS Ocean Color - MODIS Aqua: "NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI" with 'chlor_a' band - Date: August 4, 2019 - Locations: Two points in Java waters 2. Masking strategy: - Ocean color data already has quality flags - May need to check for valid data availability - The question is about chlorophyll concentration, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid chlorophyll-a ranges: typically 0.01 to 100 mg/m³ - Zero or very low values are valid in oligotrophic waters - None/Null indicates no data or calculation failure (C3) - Need to check if data exists for both locations on this specific date ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const southJava = ee.Geometry.Point([110.2273416, -8.879787]); // Southern coastal const northJava = ee.Geometry.Point([109.953683, -5.741852]); // Northern Java Sea const date = '2019-08-04'; const dateStart = ee.Date(date); const dateEnd = dateStart.advance(1, 'day'); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .select('chlor_a'); const colSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found for ${date}: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No ocean color data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the image for this date const image = collection.first(); // 3. Extract chlorophyll-a values at both locations const southStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southJava, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const northStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northJava, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const southChlor = southStats.get('chlor_a').getInfo(); const northChlor = northStats.get('chlor_a').getInfo(); // 4. Validation & Output console.log(`Southern Java (coastal): ${southChlor !== null ? southChlor.toFixed(4) : 'null'} mg/m³`); console.log(`Northern Java Sea: ${northChlor !== null ? northChlor.toFixed(4) : 'null'} mg/m³`); // Check for null or invalid values if (southChlor === null || northChlor === null) { console.log('No valid chlorophyll data at one or both locations.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for reasonable ranges (chlorophyll-a typically 0.01-100 mg/m³) if (isNaN(southChlor) || isNaN(northChlor) || southChlor < 0 || southChlor > 200 || northChlor < 0 || northChlor > 200) { console.log('Invalid chlorophyll concentration values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 5. Final Answer if (southChlor > northChlor) { console.log('Southern coastal waters have higher chlorophyll-a.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Northern Java Sea waters have equal or higher chlorophyll-a.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
